title: Beginning Sounds Worksheets | Kindergarten Phonics Practice Pack with Answer Key
desc:
📚 Common Core aligned: RF.K.2d, RF.K.3a

Give your learners extra practice with Beginning Sounds! This no-prep printable pack has 6 practice pages plus a 2-page answer key for grown-ups. Just print and go.

WHAT'S INSIDE (10 pages)

  • Cover page
  • Beginning Sounds 1
  • Beginning Sounds 2
  • b or s?
  • Which One Starts Differently?
  • Missing First Letter
  • Listen for the First Sound
  • Answer key (2 pages): every answer, plus "Say" lines for listening pages
  • Terms of use

PERFECT FOR

  • Morning work, centers and small groups
  • Homework, early finishers and review
  • Homeschool lessons and summer practice

WHY TEACHERS LOVE IT

  • Clear directions young learners can follow
  • Friendly pictures that match each word
  • Listening pages keep the words in the answer key, so children truly listen
  • Each page matches a game on Creative Sprout Learning (Beginning Sounds 1, Beginning Sounds 2, b or s?, Which One Starts Differently?, Missing First Letter, Listen for the First Sound), so children can play, then print and practice

💰 SAVE MORE: this pack is part of the Phonics & Reading Bundle and the Mega Bundle.
